devHints.origin_rejected: Dev: Better Auth rejected the request's Origin (INVALID_ORIGIN / MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN). Check BETTER_AUTH_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in .env, or add the address to EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, then restart the dev server. See docs/CODESPACES.md.
devHints.server_unavailable: Dev: the auth API answered with a server error. Check the dev server's terminal — is Postgres running and the schema pushed (npx prisma db push)?
devHints.proxy_blocked: Dev: a proxy answered instead of the app (no error code). In Codespaces, open the forwarded port again in the browser and retry.
devHints.sms_unavailable: Dev: no SMS provider answered. Without TWILIO_* in .env the code is shown on screen in development; check the dev server log.
